iti62:2.1: This set is found at [dn33:1.10.111]() and [sn48.23:1.3](), but the exact meaning is not obvious. The verses here offer our best clues, so I annotate them closely. In brief, I think the three faculties are: (1) the one on the path to arahantship; (2) one on the occasion of realizing arahantship; (3) one living as an arahant. They went on to become a standard Abhidhamma set, explained at [vb](). The set is indicative of a growing fascination with analyzing the details of what exactly happens in the process of enlightenment.
iti62:2.3: The key term is _aññā_ (“enlightenment”), which is used throughout the Suttas to indicate the realization of arahantship specifically. For this reason I am not convinced by the commentarial explanation, which takes it as the knowledge arising first in a stream-enterer. | “The faculty of understanding that one’s enlightenment is imminent” is literally, “The faculty aware that ‘I shall know the unknown’”.
iti62:3.1: The three verses seem to correlate one-by-one to the three faculties. This first line indicates that the first faculty is restricted to those who have entered the noble path. The commentary takes this as meaning *all* those who have entered the noble path, but I think it is a subset.
iti62:3.3: In the Suttas, this is normally the “knowledge of the ending of defilements”, which is characteristic of the arahant (eg. [sn12.23]()). Ending of defilements without delay is taught numerous time as the advanced meditation practice aimed squarely at arahantship in this very life, typically explained as seeing the impermanence of the five aggregates ([sn22.55:10.1](), [sn22.81:5.1](), [an5.170](), [an6.27](), [an6.28]()).
iti62:3.4: “Without delay” means “in this very life”. This seems to exclude most of those on the noble path: even the non-returners can expect one more life. Only the seventh of the eight noble individuals, those who have entered the path to arahantship, are assured of enlightenment in this very life. Taken with the previous line, this indicates that those on the path to arahantship first see that the defilements are ending, then realize arahantship itself (see [dn34:1.3.25]()).
iti62:4.4: This verse shows that the second faculty is the occasion when arahantship is realized.
iti62:5.4: The final faculty is the arahant living out their last life in peace.
